findings.summary: Spec items 1/2 ('线自判路径成引擎默认', '引擎侧机械履行六项取证义务') are still undelivered: build_line() (graphs/runner.py:205-246) never sets LineDeps.self_gate, so it defaults to None in production; the self_gate graph node is a perpetual pass-through (goal_line.py:619 returns {}), and no concrete SelfGatePort implementation exists anywhere in src/ (only the Protocol stubs at goal_line.py:292-294). perform_line_self_gate and gather_gate_evidence have no production caller. This is exactly the 'imported by no production module / exported but never invoked' defect approved.md:30 says continuous_review rejected twice, with the explicit instruction '别只交模块'. On a dd_awaiting_gate wake the six obligations are never mechanically performed.

The delivery path never mechanically enforces the six obligations: _deliver_dd -> gate_evidence_payload -> require_gate_evidence -> missing_gate_evidence only checks that six keys are truthy ('if not evidence.get(name)'), so a caller-forged six-value dict -- even one whose recorded answers are failures (e.g. {'acceptance_equality': {'equal': False}}) -- satisfies the gate. Obligations 1-6 and gate_decision are never invoked in the delivery path, so the negative criterion '漏掉任一项取证义务就投递 → 投递被拒' only reds on an absent key, not on mechanically ungathered/failed evidence.

Items 4/5 remain unintegrated end-to-end: the rationale embedded in the delivery/ledger is a digest of whatever dict was supplied (not mechanically-gathered evidence), and the positive path '自判 APPROVE → merge 后收割触发' is only asserted at the read-model unit level (tests hand-write status.json with stage='merger'); no production wiring exercises a real self-gate APPROVE flowing through the merge stage into harvestable().
